- Gevalideerde kansen voor marktuitbreiding en alternatieve inkomstenstromen onder het Squla-merk.
- Een sterk marketingteam dat eigenaarschap neemt, leert, innoveert, samenwerkt met andere teams en AI effectief inzet.


💰Wat krijg je van ons?



- 24 vrije vakantiedagen + 1 ‘spijbeldag’ (vrije dag) + 3 toegewezen vakantiedagen
- Collectief pensioen en collectieve zorgverzekering
- Een jaarlijks leerbudget van €600 voor jouw professionele ontwikkeling
- Onbeperkt toegang tot externe coaches via Inuka Coaching
- Onbeperkt toegang tot Goodhabitz voor professionele- en persoonlijke groei


Daarnaast:



- Levenslange toegang tot StudyGo en Squla-accounts
- Kantoor naast station Amsterdam Bijlmer Arena (met een Swapfiets of OV-businesscard als je >7km van het kantoor woont)
- Een MacBook om mee te werken
- Een optie tot Payroll Giving om bij te dragen aan een goed doel
- Gezonde lunches op kantoor, onbeperkt goede koffie, vers fruit en snacks
- Een Culture Crew die leuke activiteiten organiseert zoals uitjes, pubquizzen en skireizen.


😻 Wie zijn wij?

Wij zijn een gepassioneerd en divers team, samengebracht door een gedeelde missie: kinderen helpen om te groeien in hun leerproces en hen te versterken met gepersonaliseerd onderwijs.

Onze cultuur is open en authentiek – we geloven dat je het beste werk levert als je jezelf kunt zijn. Of je nu van boekenclubs, maandelijkse borrels, filmavonden, bakwedstrijden, Mario Kart-competities of skireizen houdt, bij Futurewhiz vind je een gemeenschap die als thuis voelt.

Onze platforms zijn voor iedereen, en dat geldt ook voor onze werkplek.

De kracht zit in onze verschillende achtergronden, ideeën, ervaringen en perspectieven. Deze diversiteit helpt ons om alle kinderen te ondersteunen in hun leerproces, ongeacht wie zij – of wij – zijn. Bij Futurewhiz omarmen we elkaars verschillen en creëren we een authentieke werkomgeving waarin iedereen zichzelf kan zijn. Zo maken we het ook makkelijker voor anderen om dat te doen. We zijn toegewijd aan een diverse en inclusieve cultuur, die begint op ons kantoor en zich uitstrekt over al onze platforms – en iedereen is welkom op deze reis.

🤖 Hoe we AI gebruiken

Bij Futurewhiz is AI geen losstaand project, maar onderdeel van hoe we werken. We zetten AI in om sneller te werken, nieuwe mogelijkheden te ontdekken en kinderen, ouders, leerkrachten, auteurs en redacteuren nog beter te ondersteunen.

Voor deze functie betekent AI-native zijn meer dan af en toe ChatGPT gebruiken. Het betekent dat je goed weet samen te werken met AI-tools, de resultaten kritisch controleert, zorgvuldig omgaat met gevoelige informatie en verantwoordelijkheid neemt voor de kwaliteit van wat je oplevert.

Heb je vragen over AI of over hoe we AI inzetten tijdens de sollicitatieprocedure? Stuur ons gerust een bericht via recruitment@futurewhiz.com.

Word jij onze nieuwe Marketing Lead (Squla)?

We nodigen je graag uit om te solliciteren, ook als je niet aan alle vereisten voldoet maar wel enthousiast bent.

Tip: wees vooral jezelf. We omarmen de diversiteit van al onze collega’s en zijn oprecht benieuwd naar jouw unieke perspectief.

Visa sponsorship voor deze rol is niet van toepassing. Alleen kandidaten met een geldige werkvergunning voor Nederland/EU komen in aanmerking voor deze functie.

Upload je motivatie en cv via de sollicitatieknop. We nemen dan zo snel mogelijk contact met je op.

descriptionHtml:
KICKSO ZOEKT EEN SENIOR E-COMMERCE STRATEEG

Locatie: Breda (of hybride)

Ervaring: 10+ jaar in E-commerce & Digital Marketing

Focus: Full-funnel groei, Business Strategy & Data

Ben jij de Strateeg die verder kijkt dan ROAS?

Bij KickSo geloven we niet in simpelweg ‘campagnes draaien’. Wij zijn The Outperformance Agency. Dat betekent dat we elke dag streven naar beter, scherper en meer impact. Daarom zoeken we een nieuwe zwaargewicht: een Senior E-commerce Strateeg die de spil wordt van onze e-commerce klanten.

WAT GA JE DOEN?

Jij bent niet de persoon die alleen aan de knoppen van Google Ads of Meta draait (al weet je precies hoe het moet). Jij bent de sparringpartner op directieniveau. Je praat met klanten over hun businessmodel, margestructuren en marktpositionering. Je begrijpt dat een hoge ROAS niets betekent als de Customer Lifetime Value (CLV) onder druk staat of de logistieke kosten de winst verdampen.

  • Strategisch Overzicht: Je ontwerpt kanaaloverstijgende online marketingplannen die naadloos aansluiten bij de branding en commerciële doelen van de klant.
  • Full-Funnel Groeidenken: Je bouwt strategieën voor de gehele klantreis – van internationale branding-campagnes tot aan de fijnmazige conversie-optimalisatie.
  • Data als Kompas: Je houdt het overzicht in complexe datastromen en vertaalt deze naar glasheldere inzichten en acties.
  • Kwaliteitsbewaker: Je bent de mentor voor onze specialisten en tilt het niveau van onze output continu naar een hoger plan.

WIE BEN JIJ?

Je hebt een track record waar we ‘u’ tegen zeggen (al zeggen we hier liever ‘je’). Je bent een ondernemende geest die snapt dat digitale marketing een middel is om bedrijfsdoelstellingen te behalen, geen doel op zich.

  • 10+ jaar ervaring in e-commerce en online marketing voor verschillende merken.
  • Internationale mindset: Je hebt ervaring met het schalen van merken over de grens.
  • Analytisch & Commercieel: Je droomt in funnels en praat in winstmarges.
  • Persoonlijkheid: Je brengt energie, visie en een gezonde dosis ‘niet lullen maar poetsen’ mee.

WAAROM KICKSO?

Wij wachten niet af tot de maandfee binnenkomt; wij worden zenuwachtig als er niets meer te verbeteren valt. Bij KickSo werk je in een team van specialisten die hun werk echt aan het hart gaat. We stoppen onze persoonlijkheid erin en behandelen het budget van de klant alsof het onze eigen centen zijn.

  • Een sleutelrol in een groeiend bureau met grote ambities.
  • De vrijheid om je eigen stempel te drukken op de strategische koers.
  • Samenwerken met onze AI-specialist om de nieuwste technieken direct toe te passen in je strategieën.
  • Een omgeving waar ‘outperformance’ de standaard is, maar waar we ook weten hoe we succes moeten vieren.

Wat We Bieden

Bij KickSo geloven we dat outperformance beloond moet worden. We zoeken een leider, geen volger en daar hoort een passend pakket bij:

  • Salaris: Een bruto jaarsalaris tussen de €70.000,- en €90.000,- (inclusief vakantiegeld), afhankelijk van je trackrecord en de senioriteit die je meebrengt.
  • Groei & Impact: Je krijgt een sleutelrol in de koers van het bureau en werkt nauw samen om de synergie tussen AI-workflows en menselijke strategie te maximaliseren.
  • Vrijheid & Verantwoordelijkheid: De ruimte om je eigen stempel te drukken op onze werkwijze en de groei van onze topklanten.
  • Cultuur: Een gedreven team in Breda waar we resultaten vieren en waar ‘aandacht’ geen marketingterm is, maar onze kernwaarde.

BEN JIJ ONZE NIEUWE SPIL?

Heb jij de ervaring van een veteraan en de honger van een starter? Wil jij bouwen aan merken die niet alleen opvallen, maar ook blijven hangen?

Let’s go! Stuur ons je verhaal, je resultaten en waarom jij de perfecte geschikt bent voor het strategische stokje. We leren je graag kennen.

title: Brand Manager - LEAD NL ( M/F/H )
descriptionHtml:
Everience is an international consulting group delivering AI-augmented digital services and placing people at the heart of the AI revolution.

With a presence in Europe, Africa, Asia and America, Everience offers its 4,000-strong workforce the most demanding and stimulating environment in which to transform and develop their skills, learning about new AI-based roles and building their future employability.

Through its Symbiotic Academy the group offers a unique hub for training, practical application and exchange where everyone can experiment, learn, and progress in the fields of artificial intelligence and data.

In accordance with its core purpose of orchestrating the symbiotic relationship between humans and AI in the workplace, Everience is making the augmented employee the driving force of a “symbiotic age”, where AI enhances talents and opens up new career opportunities.

Job Description

We are looking for an experienced Brand Manager - Lead NL who can translate an overarching brand strategy into impactful, locally relevant campaigns and activations for the Dutch market.

In this role, you will be responsible for developing and implementing long-term brand-building initiatives, working closely with Dutch market stakeholders and an international brand team. Your main focus will be on strengthening brand consideration, awareness and positive brand associations.

Your role:

As Brand Manager, you will lead campaigns and brand activations from strategy and creative development through implementation and evaluation. You will combine strategic thinking with hands-on execution and work closely with internal stakeholders and external agencies.

Key responsibilities:

  • Develop and implement brand campaigns and activations for the Dutch market.
  • Translate the overarching brand strategy into locally relevant plans and activities.
  • Use customer insights, brand tracking, competitor research and market trends to optimise campaigns and brand performance.
  • Identify brand challenges with internal stakeholders and translate these into clear and actionable plans.
  • Lead creative development and production and manage relationships with creative, media and research agencies.
  • Manage campaign budgets, KPIs, timelines and performance.
  • Present recommendations to senior management and advise stakeholders on brand activation strategy.
  • Work closely with Marketing, Communications, Commercial, Legal and other internal functions.
  • Contribute to knowledge sharing and the further development of the brand strategy.

Qualifications

You are an experienced Brand or Marketing professional who combines strong strategic thinking with excellent execution skills. You are comfortable operating in a complex corporate environment and know how to bring different stakeholders together around a common objective.

You have:

  • A relevant higher education degree, preferably in Marketing, Communications, Branding or a related field.
  • 5–10 years of relevant experience in branding, marketing and campaign management.
  • Proven experience developing and implementing brand campaigns and activations.
  • Experience working with creative, media and research agencies.
  • Strong stakeholder management skills and the ability to operate at both strategic and operational levels.
  • Experience managing budgets, KPIs and campaign performance.
  • The ability to connect brand strategy and activation to business challenges, customer perceptions and commercial objectives.
  • Experience within a complex international corporate environment is highly desirable.
  • Excellent command of Dutch and English.
  • Willingness to travel and work from the relevant market and headquarters when required.

Personal qualities:

  • Collaborative - you work effectively with different teams, personalities and disciplines.
  • Innovative and adaptable; you develop creative, cost-efficient solutions and navigate change effectively.
  • A strong communicator and influencer; you communicate ideas clearly and bring different viewpoints together.
  • Driven and pragmatic; you take ownership, work with urgency and remain calm under pressure.

Additional Information

What we offer:

An opportunity to take a leading role in strengthening the organisation’s brand presence in the Netherlands, working within an international brand team and combining strategic brand development with hands-on campaign delivery and activation.

All our positions are open to both women and men and are, of course, open to people with disabilities.

title: Senior Marketing Manager
descriptionHtml:
• Please note that professional fluency in written and spoken Dutch is required.

Purpose of the Role

Within the hotel’s commercial strategy and the brand and marketing frameworks of Accor and Sofitel, the Senior Marketing Manager is responsible for developing, implementing and monitoring the marketing strategy and annual marketing plan for Sofitel Legend The Grand Amsterdam.

The Senior Marketing Manager advises the Director of Sales & Marketing on positioning, marketing priorities, propositions and investments and translates the agreed commercial direction into concrete marketing, communications, PR and activation plans.

As a business partner, the Senior Marketing Manager works closely with the hotel’s operational departments to translate services, concepts and guest experiences into distinctive and commercially relevant propositions, aligned with the positioning of The Grand and the Sofitel brand identity.

The Senior Marketing Manager is responsible for the effective execution, monitoring and optimisation of these activities, using relevant commercial and marketing KPIs to measure performance and guide decision-making.

The role provides direction to the Marketing team while remaining visibly and actively involved in day-to-day execution.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop, implement and monitor the annual marketing and communications strategy in line with the hotel’s commercial objectives and Sofitel brand framework.
  • Manage the marketing budget and define relevant KPIs to measure performance, optimise activities and guide decision-making.
  • Translate market, luxury hospitality, gastronomy, travel and lifestyle trends into relevant marketing opportunities.
  • Work closely with different departments to develop distinctive, commercially relevant propositions and experiences.
  • Develop and execute integrated B2B and B2C campaigns, activations and content from concept to evaluation.
  • Strengthen the hotel’s visibility, reputation and positioning through PR, media relations, partnerships, events and relevant industry awards.
  • Safeguard consistency and quality across all content and visual communications.
  • Lead and develop the Marketing team, setting priorities and ensuring effective planning, quality and timely delivery.
  • Act as a senior marketing partner to the DOSM, management and operational departments.
  • Remain actively involved in day-to-day marketing execution, including content creation, campaign coordination, PR, events, social media and performance monitoring.
  • Lead digital marketing, social media and e-commerce activities in collaboration with Revenue & E-commerce, ensuring strong brand alignment and commercial performance.
  • Build and manage relationships with media, influencers, partners and other external stakeholders, including the coordination of press visits, events, photoshoots and relevant collaborations.
  • Provide marketing support for key hotel propositions and F&B concepts, translating guest experiences into compelling content, campaigns and commercial activations.

Profile

  • Minimum of four years of relevant marketing experience, preferably in a senior or comparable role.
  • Relevant Bachelor’s or Master’s degree.
  • Professional fluency in both Dutch and English, written and spoken.
  • Demonstrable experience in developing and executing marketing campaigns from A to Z.
  • Strong commercial and analytical capabilities, with experience in KPI-driven marketing.
  • Experience in PR, media relations, partnerships and social media.
  • Strong understanding of digital marketing and e-commerce, combined with an affinity for graphic design and visual communication.
  • Strong stakeholder-management skills and the ability to engage and influence different disciplines and operational teams.
  • Excellent prioritisation, project-management and time-management skills.
  • Proactive, creative, results-oriented and hands-on.
  • Experience in luxury hospitality, gastronomy, travel, lifestyle or another premium environment is a strong advantage.

Why choose The Grand?

  • We offer a personalized bonus plan on top of a competitive salary, travel cost arrangements and 25 holiday days a year, which you can sell and buy as well.
  • With ALL Heartists Card you receive worldwide discounts on overnight stays and more.
  • We value learning & development, therefore we provide several training sessions to stimulate your growth and knowledge.
  • A discount up to 50% in selected restaurants and bars in Amsterdam, including our own F&B offerings.
  • We find Corporate Social Responsibility very important. Our hotel as various active work groups and we have the highest Green Key certificate.
  • Be Balanced – Our Be Balanced Team will help you find a healthy work-life balance.
  • After your onboarding period, you get to be the guest and experience our legendary service for yourself in our hotel with an overnight stay, free dinner and breakfast!
  • Scale 7 of Horeca CAO.

Our employees are at the heart of our business. Bring us your initiative, passion, and energy, and we will offer you a job you love.

Would you like to know more about our hotel?

Sofitel Legend The Grand Amsterdam offers five-star luxury in a unique, historic Amsterdam setting, infused with French elegance and grandeur. The Grand is part of the Accor hotel group. Visit our website and follow us on Instagram and LinkedIn.

Don’t miss this opportunity and apply!

Click “Apply” and make sure to include your CV and cover letter. Take the next step towards your next career opportunity—we look forward to getting to know you.

companyDescription:
UNIQUE HISTORICAL AMBIANCE
Located between two gentle canals in the heart of the city, The Grand boasts a rich history; from a 15th-century convent to royal lodgings, to the headquarters of the Admiralty to the City Hall of Amsterdam. The hotel offers five-star luxury in a unique ambiance, furnished with French elegance and grandeur. The spacious, luxurious accommodations, the exceptional food and beverage proposition, the historic meeting and event venues, the indulgent Sofitel SPA and the beautiful Garden Terrace captivate and seduce everyone into visiting the hotel. 

ROOMS & SUITES
The Grand features 178 contemporary accommodations and 30 luxury suites with Butler service. The interior of the rooms is a harmonious blend of traditional and contemporary design, including typically Dutch style elements. The rich heritage of the site has been carefully preserved while ensuring that the accommodations are equipped with the advanced technology expected by today’s traveller.

CULINARY INDULGENCE
The legendary location, which once served as the canteen of the former Town Hall, is now a place where gourmands can savour the delights of restaurant Bridges, gardenbistro Oriole, the Garden Terrace, Library ‘Or’ and The Flying Dutchman. 

Fine dining restaurant Bridges is located on one of Amsterdam’s oldest canals and is the ultimate place to go to for a business lunch or an elaborate dinner. Choose between a wide variety of à la carte options or a special Chef’s menu (4, 5 or 7 courses) to enjoy from. A unique feature of Bridges is the Chef’s Table in the heart of the kitchen, where you can enjoy the magic of the kitchen brigade up close. Additionally, Bridges also offers a private dining area for groups up to 12 people.. 

Oriole is a casual, laid-back bistro, celebrating the most loved and recognized cuisines in the world, Mediterranean food. The seasonally rotating menu features recognizable Mediterranean dishes, that encompass simplicity, personality and flavour.

title: Senior Marketing Strategist
descriptionHtml:
This Is What We Offer You

  • Salary: Gross monthly salary between EUR 5,030 and EUR 7,183 (scale 09) for a 36-hour work week.
  • Extras: a thirteenth month, 8% holiday allowance, and a 10% Employee Benefit Budget.
  • Development budget: EUR 1,400 development budget per year for your growth and development.
  • Hybrid working: a balance between home and office work (possible for most roles).
  • Pension: decide for yourself the amount of your personal contribution.

Or view all our benefits.

We are looking for an experienced and strategic Senior Marketing Strategist to drive consumer engagement, adoption, and communication strategies across our initiatives within Area Consumer Interaction, Tribe Tech4Engneering at Rabobank.

You & your role

In this role, you will act as the strategic marketing partner to the Product Owner of our marketing squad. Together with the squad members, you will help translate consumer insights into compelling positioning, messaging, communication strategies, and adoption plans that maximize the value of our products and services, while actively contributing to the development of the team through mentoring and capability building.

Examples for practices

  • Develop marketing strategies that support long-term objectives and deliver measurable business impact.
  • Lead end-to-end communication and engagement campaigns from planning through performance evaluation.
  • Establish KPI frameworks that measure campaign effectiveness, customer engagement, and adoption outcomes

Facts & figures

  • 36 or 40 hours per week

Top 3 Responsibilities

  • Develop and drive strategic marketing plans that align consumer needs, business priorities, and long-term organisational objectives while delivering measurable impact.
  • Lead positioning, messaging, communication, and adoption strategies that clearly articulate customer value and support successful product launches.
  • Build trusted stakeholder relationships while advising teams and lead stakeholders using consumer insights, performance data, and strategic recommendations

Working within Area Consumer Interaction, Tribe Tech4Engineering, this role acts as a strategic marketing partner to the Product Owner and collaborates across squads, tribes, and leadership teams to maximise user value and adoption.

Together we achieve more than alone

We believe in the power of differences. It is precisely by combining people's differences that we become an even better bank. We are curious about what you add to our squad within Area Consumer Interaction.

You will work in Squad Lighthouse, a strategic marketing and communications squad within Area Consumer Interaction. Our mission is to drive awareness, understanding, and adoption of technology solutions across Rabobank. We help internal teams discover and adopt the right standard technology products, enabling greater consistency, efficiency, and value creation throughout the bank. Collaboration is at the heart of everything we do. As a strategic, consumer-centric, and results-driven team, we bring together communications, engagement, and adoption expertise to help our technology tribe achieve its goals and accelerate the successful use of standard technology solutions across Rabobank.

Work on yourself and the world around you at the same time

For us, your development and that of society go hand in hand. That’s why we want to invest in you and work together for a better world. We summarise this in one sentence: ‘At Rabobank, you work on yourself and the world around you at the same time. You’ll see this reflected in your personal development budget, our hybrid working environment, and a healthy balance between work and home. You can work on banking services for our private and business customers, as well as societal issues such as food and energy transitions.

Why everyone is welcome at Rabobank

At Rabobank, we believe we become stronger through people who complement each other. By embracing our differences, we bring out the best in one another. We seek diversity in areas such as knowledge, skills, and experience, but also in gender, background, and culture. Across every department, we strive for variety and the freedom to be yourself – whoever you are. That’s what diversity and inclusion at Rabobank is all about

You & your talent

  • Bachelor's or master's degree in marketing, Communications, Business Administration, Economics, or a related field.
  • Minimum 7 years of experience in marketing strategy, product marketing, consumer engagement, communications, adoption, or related disciplines.
  • Proven track record of developing and executing successful strategic marketing and communication initiatives.
  • Experience working within Agile environments and collaborating closely with multidisciplinary teams.

Apply

To ensure that we assess all candidates equally for suitability for this position, we do not require a mandatory cover letter. Instead, we ask all candidates the same three questions to see how your profile matches the role. Please pay sufficient attention to answering these questions and explaining your answers. together with your CV, these responses form the basis for our evaluation in this round. Submitting both a CV and answers to the three questions is the minimum requirement to be considered in the selection process. A cover letter is not mandatory but may be submitted optionally.

You may draw on your work experience, volunteer work, education, private life, and so on. Use a maximum of 200 words per question and provide no more than two examples. Below are the questions:

  • How have you used customer insights to shape a successful marketing, communication, or adoption strategy?
  • Can you describe a strategic initiative where you influenced stakeholders and delivered measurable business impact?
  • How do you measure the success of marketing and engagement activities, and how have you used data to improve outcomes?

Please submit these answers (combined with your motivational letter) in the application section titled ‘Add your cover letter (optional)’ on the website portal.

You & the application process

You can apply for the Senior Marketing Strategist vacancy at Rabobank, until fulfilment.

  • Questions about working at Rabobank and the process? Ashley Lumbantobing, IT Recruiter via ashley.lumbantobing@rabobank.nl
  • If you are invited for an interview, Bo, our virtual assistant, will contact you via SMS and email to schedule it.
  • Answers to frequently asked questions can be found at Rabobank rabobank.jobs/en/faq
  • A reliability check is part of the procedure.
  • We respect your privacy.

To be considered for this position, you must be located in the Netherlands and have the legal right to work in the Netherlands. We are unable to consider candidates requiring relocation from another country.

title: Integrated Marketing Experience Team Lead | FMCG | English
descriptionHtml:
Are you an experienced integrated marketing professional who thrives on turning brand strategy into standout campaigns, and looking for a role where you can shape a brand-new function from the ground up? We are looking for an IMX Team Lead on behalf of our client, an international food and beverage company that has been scaling quickly across its European operations.


Key Responsibilities

Campaign Delivery and Execution

  • Convert regional marketing strategies into coordinated, multi-channel activation plans deployed across European markets
  • Take ownership of execution across paid, owned, earned, and retail touchpoints, keeping messaging consistent while allowing for local market adaptation
  • Coordinate campaign schedules and delivery timelines across multiple countries and internal teams
  • Ensure all marketing assets align with brand guidelines and applicable local regulatory requirements

Agency and Production Management

  • Serve as the primary link between the brand team and external agencies, including creative, media, production, print, and experiential partners
  • Assess agency proposals and recommendations before they reach the brand team, adding a layer of creative and strategic judgement
  • Write clear project briefs and hold agency partners to agreed quality, timing, and cost standards
  • Own assigned marketing budgets, optimise spend for return on investment, and manage purchase orders in line with internal processes
  • Evaluate agency performance on an ongoing basis

Consumer and Digital Activation

  • Coordinate consumer-facing activity across social media, digital advertising, influencer partnerships, and experiential formats including sampling and tastings
  • Apply platform-specific judgement, recognising that campaign performance is measured differently across social media channels
  • Support e-commerce activation in partnership with key online retail partners
  • Monitor and report on campaign performance and consumer engagement

Product Launch Execution

  • Lead the in-market rollout of new product launches across Europe, working across brand, trade marketing, and supply chain teams
  • Manage the development and delivery of launch assets, point of sale materials, and customer-facing communications within agreed timelines
  • Adapt launch plans to individual market requirements where appropriate

Retail and Customer Marketing

  • Develop and execute in-store activation programmes in partnership with the Trade Marketing team, aimed at improving brand visibility and purchase conversion
  • Manage the development and distribution of point-of-sale materials, promotional assets, and merchandising programmes
  • Track campaign results and recommend adjustments based on performance

Stakeholder and Project Coordination

  • Act as the central connector between Marketing, Trade Marketing, external agencies, and international headquarters
  • Keep stakeholders aligned throughout planning and execution phases
  • Prepare performance reports and presentations for leadership as required
  • Run multiple concurrent projects without losing delivery quality or missing agreed milestones
  • Identify execution risks early and implement mitigation plans before they affect campaign delivery


Qualifications & Skills

  • Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business Administration, or a related discipline
  • At least 10 years of experience in brand, integrated marketing, or campaign activation within an international FMCG environment, with meaningful time spent in a senior or lead capacity
  • Prior experience in a role connecting brand teams with external agencies, ideally from a client-side function rather than exclusively agency-side
  • Demonstrated track record managing integrated campaigns across multiple European markets, covering paid, owned, and earned channels
  • Hands-on experience managing creative, media, and production agencies from brief through delivery, with full budget oversight
  • Solid commercial awareness, with the ability to balance brand investment against business performance within defined campaign budgets
  • Genuine, platform-level understanding of how to reach and engage consumers across digital and social channels
  • Resilient and stakeholder savvy, with the ability to keep pace in an environment where priorities shift regularly
  • Professional fluency in English, written and spoken
  • Background in FMCG companies known for operating integrated marketing or content execution functions is highly preferred
  • Experience working alongside or managing in-house creative or production teams is highly preferred
  • Familiarity with European retail environments and omnichannel campaigns across multiple markets is preferred
  • Professional fluency in an additional European language is an advantage


What We Offer

  • A salary range between 80,000€ – 135,000€ excluding 8% holiday allowance according to experience.
  • Pension plan
  • Commuting benefit
  • Vitality Benefit (€50 a month)
  • Lease Bike Option
  • 25 days of paid time off
  • Company laptop & phone
  • Free Accident & WIA Gap insurance
  • Hybrid working, currently four days in the office and one day working from home
  • Regular collaboration across a wide range of European markets and with international headquarters, offering broad exposure
  • The opportunity to build out a new discipline and define how it integrates with the wider marketing team
  • A fast-paced, international working environment


Interested? Feel free to apply!


Please note that we can only consider applicants who are currently based in the Netherlands and who will not require visa sponsorship now or in the future.

title: Senior Marketing Manager Hematology
descriptionHtml:
Build Our Future Together

At Regeneron, we use science and innovation to develop life-changing medicines for people with serious diseases. We are seeking a Senior Marketing Manager Hematology Marketing Europe to join our Hematology International marketing team, supporting Austria, Switzerland and the Nordics. In this role, you will own the launch of key hematology assets, drive brand strategy and execution across multiple European markets, and collaborate with cross-functional and cross-regional stakeholders. This position offers the opportunity to contribute to a science-driven organization passionate about improving outcomes for patients worldwide.

When & Where

Location: Netherlands

Work model: Hybrid

Discover Your Role

  • Lead the development and execution of hematology brand plans across Austria, Switzerland and the Nordics, aligning local priorities with global strategy.
  • Drive the launch of two hematology assets across six geographies, ensuring effective execution in competitive markets.
  • Analyze market dynamics, identify growth opportunities and risks, and develop differentiated messaging and action plans to support brand performance.
  • Partner with Medical Affairs and cross-functional teams to develop and implement market strategies, promotional activities and stakeholder engagement plans.
  • Adapt global campaigns and materials for local field and digital use while promoting consistency and best-practice sharing across markets.
  • Collaborate with Commercial Operations, Sales and external partners to implement field plans, communications, cycle meetings and customer engagement initiatives.
  • Manage promotional budgets, recommend investment priorities and monitor spending to support business objectives.
  • Build strong partnerships, gather customer insights and maintain high standards of compliance and ethical conduct.

This Role Requires

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Science or a related field, with 8-10+ years of biotech or pharmaceutical brand marketing experience.
  • Significant oncology and/or hematology expertise, including successful launches of specialty medicines in competitive environments.
  • Experience developing and delivering brand strategies across multiple markets, managing budgets, agencies and external partners.
  • Experience in Multiple Myeloma, Follicular Lymphoma or Diffuse Large B-Cell Lymphoma, exposure to multiple European markets, and additional European language skills are advantageous.

title: Strateeg
descriptionHtml:
Met de juiste energie ben jij dé aangewezen strateeg om non-stop sterke merken te bouwen.

Jij, onze nieuwe strateeg

Heb je bij één of meerdere bureaus meegebouwd aan A-merken in verschillende B2C sectoren, op strategisch én commercieel niveau? Krijg je energie van het laten groeien van jouw klanten op basis van jouw strategische visie en proactieve advies? Is de werkwijze van een creatief bureau niet nieuw voor je? En ben je bekend met (merk)strategische modellen, frameworks en theorieën? Dan zouden we zomaar een match kunnen zijn!

Als strateeg bij Megawatt ben je richting klanten de eigenaar van de strategische klantrelatie en richting collega’s de verbinder tussen het merk en creatief werk. In deze rol ben je inhoudelijk eindverantwoordelijk en bewaak je de voortgang van projecten in o.a. reviews, presentaties en doorvertalingen. Je praat op eigen initiatief met klanten over de uitdagingen van het merk, de wensen van de doelgroep en de nuances binnen cultuur. Je doet dit door ontbrekende informatie boven water te krijgen, proactief jouw visie te delen en scherpe keuzes te maken. Alleen zo kom je snel tot de kern van het grote geheel.

Aan de hand van jouw visie en strategie zet je het creatieve team aan de slag, beoordeel je creatieve concepten en bewaak je de aansluiting van bedachte concepten aan deze strategie. Jouw inzichten werken als aanjager en stroomversneller voor ons creatieve concepting team. Je weet hoe je dit team moet briefen en geeft hierbij duidelijke kaders. Zonder goede briefing, geen goed werk.

Jij wacht niet op een briefing van een van je client lead collega’s, maar initieert zelf de gesprekken om samen met klanten tot briefings te komen. Je komt proactief met je ideeën op de merken waar je op werkt en ziet een groeiend account als jouw succes. Je brengt projecten naar een goed einde omdat jij je er verantwoordelijk voor voelt, niet omdat iemand je erop wijst.

Hier krijg jij energie van

  • Complexe problemen simpel maken
  • Het voortouw nemen op strategie en inhoud
  • Je vraagt net zo lang door tot je echt alle informatie hebt
  • Ongevraagd met een plan komen waar de klant nog niet om had gevraagd
  • Een account zien groeien door jouw advies en dit als jouw verdienste claimen

Je brengt mee

  • Minimaal 5 jaar ervaring als strateeg bij een (creatief) bureau. Bureauervaring is voor ons een must: je kent het ritme van bureaus en weet hoe je klanten commercieel uitbouwt.
  • Aantoonbaar commercieel eigenaarschap. Je kunt voorbeelden geven van accounts die je op jouw initiatief hebt laten groeien.
  • Sterk begrip van hoe on- en offline mediakanalen bijdragen aan het bouwen van een krachtig merk
  • Ervaring binnen meerdere van de volgende strategische disciplines: campagnestrategie, merkstrategie, mediastrategie, creatieve strategie, contentstrategie of influencer- en socialstrategie

Wij

We zijn ontstaan uit energie - het is wie we zijn. Wanneer energie klopt, gaat alles vanzelf. We stoppen die energie in onze projecten én in onze processen. In ideeën en designs die indruk maken. In producties die we tot leven brengen op een manier waar anderen niet eens van durven dromen. We stoppen niet voordat alles beweegt op lichtsnelheid. Dán weten we dat we precies zijn waar we moeten zijn. Het maakt ons een 360° powerhouse dat maximale energie creëert én levert.

We zetten intrinsiek gemotiveerde specialisten in hun kracht via slimme, heldere processen. We ontgrendelen het volledige potentieel van merken én van mensen. De juiste energie werkt aanstekelijk. Klanten voelen het zodra ze aan tafel zitten. Nieuwe collega’s merken het zodra ze binnenstappen. Het zit in het hart van onze overtuigingen, de kern van onze creativiteit en de vonk achter elke beslissing die we nemen. We supercharge brands.

What's in it for you

Energie en de nodige humor. Onze boog staat vaak gespannen maar gelachen wordt er. En veel. Hier ga je ook heel blij van worden;

  • Een plek in een bureau dat groeit en waar je direct impact hebt op werk én cultuur
  • Ruimte voor ontwikkeling, verdieping en ownership
  • Je krijgt vrijheid en verantwoordelijkheid. Niet alleen binnen je klanten, maar ook in hoe je jouw eigen energie inzet en richting geeft
  • Onbeperkt vakantiedagen
  • Flexibele werktijden
  • En nog veel meer!

Bij een uitdagende baan hoort een goed salaris. We bespreken na jouw sollicitatie direct de verwachtte salarisschaal. Heldere verwachtingen voor beide.

descriptionHtml:
Define the market position of a product or brand, within the context of the overall product strategy, by conducting competitor analysis and market research, working with the sales team, and driving marketing initiatives to support product or brand awareness and sales. In addition to taking the product to market, this role is responsible for ensuring that the product meets the needs of the market and that data and research gained in the marketplace shape future product direction. Articulate the product and feature benefits and translate them into customer messaging. Give product demonstrations at trade shows and webinars, delivering presentations and creating marketing collateral. Responsible for bringing the product to market, driving adoption, and equipping the sales team with the knowledge and tools to be successful.

Job Description

About the position

Help shape the next chapter of some of the Netherlands’ most iconic brands.

As Senior Brand Manager Drinks & Brunch, you will lead the marketing agenda for Karvan Cévitam, De Ruijter, Venz and Brinta. These brands have a strong place in Dutch households. Your opportunity is to build on that heritage and give consumers more reasons to choose them today and tomorrow.

Based in Amsterdam and reporting to the Business Leader Drinks & Brunch, you will be part of the Brand Category team.

The role combines strategic judgement with hands-on delivery. You will develop campaigns, launch innovation and lead execution with the marketing team and agencies. Working closely with Category, Sales, Finance, RGM, R&D and Supply, including our factory, you will turn ideas into commercially viable plans and deliver them in-market.

You will also coach a Junior Brand Manager, developing their skills, confidence and ownership.

Your Responsibilities

  • Set brand strategies and priorities, translating them into focused three-year and annual plans to build brand equity and drive commercial growth.

Turn consumer insights into strong creative briefs and opportunities for growth.

  • Lead creative and media agencies to develop and deliver effective campaigns, content and activation.
  • Drive innovation and renovation from concept to launch, working with R&D, Supply and our factory to ensure feasibility and readiness.
  • Partner with Category and Sales to bring brand plans to life through compelling shopper activation in-store and online.
  • Manage the marketing budget, working with Finance and RGM to prioritize investment and evaluate brand and business results.

What You Bring

  • 6+ years of experience in FMCG brand marketing, with a track record of delivering campaigns and innovation that build brands and drive growth.

Proven experience leading creative and media agencies, with strong creative judgement.

  • The ability to combine consumer understanding and data to make clear marketing decisions.
  • Commercial understanding and experience bringing cross-functional teams together to deliver business results.
  • Clear communication and the confidence to influence senior stakeholders.

A hands-on approach: you take initiative, make decisions and keep projects moving.

  • The ability and motivation to develop others. Previous people management experience is a plus.
  • A relevant master’s degree and business-fluent Dutch and English.

What We Offer You

  • An ambitious employer; we only want the best for you;
  • A fast career track like only few other companies can match;
  • A competitive salary and excellent bonus structure (above market);
  • Always room for new insights; if you have an idea- please let us know- and we can set it in action!

Amsterdam

descriptionHtml:
About The Job

Are you looking for a new opportunity and do you get excited by the world of plantbased ? Well, then we have great news for you! We are looking for a Senior Brand Manager Alpro to dive into the wonderful world of marketing plantbased. The job is covering a BeNeLux scope and is ideally located in Rijswijk in Netherland, but can also be in Brussels in Belgium.

Get a great taste of life in “FMCG” (aka “fast moving consumer goods”, or in human language brands and products you can find when exploring your local supermarket) in a dynamic, enthusiastic and incredibly talented team (maybe we should add humble too?). Oh well, all joking aside you may just have found your dream job! Hungry to apply? Let’s go!

In this role, you will be driving the growth of Plant-Based & Alpro through developing and executing effective marketing strategies. You will be part of the Plant-Based Marketing Benelux team, together with team of (Sr) Brand Managers and will be reporting directly into the Plant-Based Marketing Director. In this role, you will be coaching a team of 2-4 people, composed of Brand Managers, Junior Brand Managers and interns.

Your key responsibilities are

From a strategic perspective, you will be responsible to create annual growth strategy and brand plans for BeNeLux on your category scope plantbased yoghurts (PBY). This includes

  • Design of the brand plans for Belgium and Netherlands in close collaboration with cross departments (sales, finance, catman, shopper, RGM, media, Strategic & insights team…). Delivering clear “jobs to be done” and priorities, on all that relates to our Alpro plantbased yoghurt in Alpro.
  • With support of your team, You’ll lead the implementation of those brand plans and track the business results along the way, taking action when needed to reach the ambitions.
  • You own and deliver significant elements of the annual category and brand planning process from proactively identifying gaps/opportunities & following closely business results, through to presentation sign-off and sales presentations, together with your team.
  • Your business skills, retail knowledge, strategic and growth mindset are essential in that role.

From a Portfolio & Inno/Reno perspective, you will lead portfolio strategy and co-lead the plant-based inno/reno projects with project management team and your team. This includes

  • Portfolio management including innovations, renovations falling under the PBY category for the alpro brand
  • You work with your key stakeholders to deliver the annual sales and business objectives, across the company’s main product categories and innovations.
  • Together with CatMan you manage the portfolio priorities and define the national assortment cards.
  • Working hand in hand with the European portfolio team, you voice the local BeNelux needs and align to build the ideal portfolio pipeline.
  • New Product Development launches & post-launches You lead the category and product planning process for your market. Delivering the right innovation and renovation projects on time, in full, at target.
  • You work closely together with the global plant-based acceleration unit and IPRO team to ensure full and timely delivery of inno and reno project.
  • You work together with Category Management to build the consumer, sales and business cases to back-up proposed solutions.
  • You work with PRGM/Finance to deliver clear P&L’s for each proposed inno/reno – focusing on growing topline and bottom-line.
  • You regularly present and advocate plans to other functional teams and commercial contacts. You proactively manage feedback within those conversations.
  • You rollout launch(es), with and together with your sales and category colleagues.
  • Together with category management, you set clear KPI’s for each innovation and track these and the total performance in market, assess ROI at post-launch review and advise changes where necessary.

From an Equity, Brand & Activation perspective, you will be responsible for your own Growth Events & Equity platforms. This will include

  • Brand Campaigns and Activation You are responsible to set up engaging 360 campaigns promoting the Alpro brand & key growth platforms ATL & BTL
    • You co-create the Growth Event calendar reflecting on local excellence in execution through strategic collaboration with our creative & media agency.
    • You collaborate with the media team BE/NL & agencies to design full offline & online marketing campaigns with good campaign & media brief and co-own community / influencer management.
    • You feed into the objective of each campaign & KPI’s to measure post campaign performance (from both media & brand perspective).
    • You monitor the campaign analysis closely monitor our campaigns, collect market & consumer insights, followed by implementing our learnings and continuously optimizing our campaigns.
    • You provide thought leadership to the team by connecting marketing mix elements and materials, ensuring best-in-class execution.
    • You feed into the shopper team giving input on hero products for the growth events, building strong inter-connection to ensure in-store excellence.
From a stakeholder and leadership perspective, as owner of the local Alpro PBY portfolio, you liaise with the right stakeholders to ensure timely and on target delivery of the business objectives.

  • You work closely together with key global & EU stakeholder.
  • You work together with key local stakeholders to fully leverage the power of our brand and category KAMs, Cat Man, R&I, S&I, IPRO, Field D2D-team, Finance.
  • You report into the Plant-based Marketing Director. Making sure they have the right information available to validate business, portfolio & equity decisions and push the local agenda within the local business team.
  • You leverage your leadership & team engagement to further develop the capabilities within the team and your N-1(s).

About you

To be successful in this role, you

  • Have significant marketing experience (8+ years), ideally within FMCG, with ownership of brands, categories, or portfolios.
  • Excel in developing brand and category strategies, translating annual operating plans (AOP) into impactful tactics that strengthen brand equity and drive demand.
  • Build strong relationships and collaborate effectively across functions, partnering with Sales, R&I, S&I, Category Management, Finance and other key stakeholders to deliver business objectives.
  • Demonstrate strong leadership in innovation, renovation and communication projects, managing initiatives both locally and across European markets.
  • Successfully manage integrated marketing campaigns, leading projects from insight and ideation through execution and performance evaluation across multiple channels.
  • Combine strategic thinking with creativity, feeling comfortable building business cases with limited data and finding solutions to complex business challenges.
  • Have strong analytical skills, including experience working with Nielsen, GfK and other market, consumer and performance data sources.
  • Manage budgets effectively, including annual planning, investment allocation, performance tracking and ROI analysis.
  • Show a proactive, entrepreneurial mindset, working independently, adapting to change and continuously seeking opportunities to learn and improve.
  • Are passionate about the plant-based category and inspired by brands that contribute positively to health, people and the planet.
  • Are fluent in Dutch and English; French is considered an advantage.
  • Hold a Master's degree in Marketing, Communications, Economics, Digital Marketing or a related field (or an equivalent Bachelor's degree with relevant experience).

About us

All Danoners receive a complete package of benefits. This includes a competitive salary and yearly bonus, a premium free pension, 30 days of annual leave (with the opportunity to purchase more) and you will receive a monthly health care allowance. In addition, you can get discount on your gym membership, and we offer initiatives focused on nutrition, physical, and mental health. We provide continuous learning opportunities through workshops, online courses and training sessions.

In the Netherlands we also offer a hybrid working environment which enables each team to meet our people's desire for flexibility. You can work from one of our People Hubs in Hoofddorp, Utrecht and Rijswijk or you can work from home.

What's Next

It’s simple – hit the “apply” button before the application deadline of October 20th 2026. In order to comply with GDPR we can’t process your personal data without your given consent, so please apply directly via this website. Good luck! We can’t wait to meet you.

We put people at the center of everything we do. Bring your unique perspective, ambitions and ideas to the table – the impact you could make might surprise you. We are committed to embrace diversity, nurturing an inclusive workplace where every individual is valued; Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion (DEI) is deeply embedded in Danone's DNA.

Need more information? Please contact Susanne Burger-van der Zwart, Talent Scout via susanne.burger-van-der-zwart@danone.com

  • All applications will be considered for a vacancy without discrimination based on ethnicity, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, nationality, disability, or any other protected status.

  • Regularly perform co-visits with KAMs, organize compliant engagements with therapeutic area experts to inform the strategy, projects and to coach on implementation

Market Access And Stakeholder Strategy

  • Work closely with Market Access, Medical, and Sales to ensure aligned value narratives, evidence plans, and stakeholder engagement strategies.
  • Support access planning, guideline inclusion, network development, and institutional positioning, particularly in complex hospital and tender-driven environments.
  • Contribute to strategies for key accounts, centers of excellence, and national or regional decision-making bodies. Provide valuable input to the preparation of national and local tenders

Cross-functional And Matrix Leadership

  • Act as a central integrator across Sales, Medical, Market Access, Finance, and Global/Regional Marketing
  • Lead cross-functional brand teams with clear objectives, accountability, and delivery focus
  • Manage budgets, agencies, and external partners with strong ROI mindset and execution excellence

Compliance, Quality And Governance

  • Ensure that all promotional activities and materials meet medical, legal, and regulatory standards and that adverse events, product complaints, and safety information are reported accurately and in a timely manner

  • Highly analytical, with the ability to transform complex data and insights into clear decisions and actions
  • Demonstrated ability to influence without authority and to lead cross-functional and field teams in a matrix organization

  • Entrepreneurial, performance-driven mindset with strong ownership, accountability, and resilience
  • Deep commitment to compliance, quality, and patient-centricity

Computer Skills

title: Gaming & Consumer Marketing Lead - Europe
descriptionHtml:
Gaming is at the heart of this role and represents around 90% of its scope. We’re looking for someone who knows the gaming world well and brings strong, hands-on experience in the industry or gaming ecosystem.

About The Role

You’ll own the European marketing strategy across our gaming and consumer portfolio, covering AOC, AGON, Philips Monitors and Evnia.

This is a senior, hands-on role with real ownership across brand, product and commercial marketing. You’ll shape how our products show up across European markets - from positioning and launches to partnerships, digital presence, retail visibility and sell-through - working closely with Product Marketing, Communications & Advertising, Digital, E-commerce and our local markets.

What you'll own

Strategy and planning

  • Own the European gaming and consumer marketing strategy and annual plan across both brands.
  • Develop and challenge country plans against local sales goals, business priorities and market opportunities.
  • Track competitors, gaming trends, consumer behaviour and market developments to identify gaps and opportunities and keep the strategy evidence-led.

Brand, product and content

  • Shape product positioning together with Product Marketing, with a clear focus on priority and flagship products.
  • Drive brand consistency and quality across consumer-facing activity for both brands.
  • Own the quality, relevance and visibility of consumer-facing content across our websites.
  • Work with Communications & Advertising on the direction and content of our social channels.

Launches, partnerships and events

  • Lead gaming and consumer product launches from strategy through activation, aligning positioning, content, channels, partnerships and events across European markets.
  • Own gaming and consumer partnerships, including evaluating their impact, visibility and activation across markets.
  • Lead our presence at relevant consumer events and tradeshows.

Commercial impact

  • Connect marketing activity directly to commercial performance, improving product visibility, conversion and sell-through across retail and e-tail partners.

Leadership, budget and reporting

  • Lead, prioritise and develop the Consumer Marketing team.
  • Own performance KPIs and the marketing budget, including allocation across design, specialist support and digital activity.
  • Set the B2C strategic direction in partnership with Communications & Advertising, ensuring PR and advertising support the wider marketing strategy.
  • Report on performance and review results with the Director and European markets.

What you bring

  • Strong professional experience in gaming marketing, with a genuine understanding of the gaming audience, ecosystem and category.
  • Substantial consumer marketing experience, ideally within consumer electronics, gaming or another fast-moving technology category.
  • A track record of owning brand and product marketing across multiple European markets.
  • Experience leading and developing a small team.
  • Strong commercial awareness and a clear understanding of how marketing activity translates into sell-through.
  • Confidence owning budgets, KPIs and performance reporting for senior stakeholders.
  • Fluent English; another European language is an advantage.
  • Willingness to travel within Europe for events and market visits.

Why this role

This is a high-ownership European role with direct influence on strategy, launches, partnerships and commercial performance.

You’ll work across established and fast-growing gaming and consumer brands, lead a team, own meaningful budget and help shape how our products reach consumers across Europe.

AOC is a global leader in display technology, delivering innovative monitors for home, office, and gaming—backed by a passion for quality and user experience. Our portfolio spans productivity-boosting business screens to AGON by AOC, the world-leading gaming lineup that powers everyone from aspiring creators to esports pros. We move fast, think globally, and build responsibly, with transparent sustainability goals guiding how we design, manufacture, and support our products. If you’re eager to grow, collaborate across borders, and help millions see more every day, join us.

title: Senior Marketeer
descriptionHtml:
Wil jij bouwen aan merken en licenties die dagelijks zichtbaar zijn in Europa?

Bij Vadobag krijg je de kans om de marketingstrategie vorm te geven en uit te voeren voor onze eigen merken Kidzroom en Studio V én voor ruim 35 bekende internationale licenties zoals Disney Stitch, Bluey en PAW Patrol.

Je werkt nauw samen met directie, sales en design en krijgt veel ruimte om ideeën om te zetten in content en campagnes. Vanuit ons kantoor en showroom in Tilburg speel je een belangrijke rol in de verdere groei van onze organisatie, merken en licenties binnen Europa.

Als Senior Marketeer krijg je de kans om een brede en invloedrijke rol te vervullen. title: Merkstrateeg
descriptionHtml:
Terug naar vacatures

Merkstrateeg

Fulltime, in Rotterdam, Stellendam

Solliciteer direct

Heb jij een eigenzinnige kijk op communicatie en merkstrategie? En wil je ambitieuze organisaties op creatieve wijze helpen met een unieke positionering? Als Merkstrateeg bij WebNL creative studios druk je je stempel op het strategische en creatieve werk dat we opleveren. Altijd met een helder doel voor ogen, want als senior in het vak weet jij wat werkt.

Hoe ziet jouw nieuwe functie eruit?

Als Merkstrateeg vertaal je complexe vraagstukken naar heldere business- en merkstrategieën, positionering en creatieve richtingen. Je dringt door tot de kern: welk probleem lossen we op, wat staat er op het spel voor de business en met welke keuzes maken we echt het verschil? Daarna zet je de lijn uit en geef je heldere richting aan concept en uitvoering.

Je ontwikkelt en faciliteert workshops, strategische sessies en presentaties om de juiste inzichten boven tafel te krijgen. Voordat je met het team nadenkt over oplossingen, zorg jij ervoor dat het probleem écht scherp is. Je werkt zelfstandig en adviseert klanten op directie- en managementniveau. Je koppelt keuzes aan organisatiedoelen en maakt ze uitvoerbaar voor teams.

Jij vertaalt de visie en het doel van de klant naar een merkstrategie die richting geeft voor keuzes in propositie, communicatie en kanalen. Dat kan een commerciële insteek hebben, maar ook een maatschappelijke. In alle gevallen bouw je aan een merk, want merkdenken zit nu eenmaal in je. Merkverhalen horen daar onlosmakelijk bij. Jij kunt verwoorden waar een merk voor staat en waarom het ertoe doet. Je zet dat verhaal neer als richtinggever voor communicatie, content, campagnes en design.

Je staat stevig in je advies en durft ‘nee’ te zeggen als dat nodig is. Daarmee speel je een centrale rol binnen WebNL.

Samen met een team van 60 professionals op het gebied van marketing, design en development werk je enerzijds voor grote organisaties als Visma, provincie Zuid-Holland en Fox (ANWB) en anderzijds voor start-ups, goede doelen en MKB+ ondernemers. Die variatie blijft inspireren. Bekijk ook onze cases.

Hoe maak jij WebNL nog beter?

  • Je hebt ruim 10 jaar relevante bureau-ervaring als senior op het gebied van communicatie- en merkstrategie
  • Je beweegt je makkelijk op strategisch niveau en adviseert klanten zelfstandig
  • Je weet duidelijk, inspirerend en overtuigend je verhaal over te brengen
  • Je combineert creativiteit met business strategie
  • Je bent taalvaardig en kunt complexe keuzes helder verwoorden, mondeling en schriftelijk
  • Je bent empathisch, begrijpt ieders belang en kunt goed luisteren
  • Je bent een echte teamplayer die ook individueel goed uit de voeten kan
  • Je bent innovatief, nieuwsgierig en altijd op de hoogte van de nieuwste AI-ontwikkelingen
  • Je vindt plezier in je werk de belangrijkste arbeidsvoorwaarde

En wat bieden we jou?

Natuurlijk zijn je arbeidsvoorwaarden en pensioenregeling goed! Maar er is meer…

  • Een salaris vanaf €4.509 tot en met €6.434 (afhankelijk van jouw ervaring)
  • Regelmatig sportlessen met collega’s of korting op je eigen sportschool
  • Coachingssessies om te groeien met je team
  • Elke dag een verse, gezonde lunch
  • Budget om jezelf te ontwikkelen door trainingen en conferenties te bezoeken
  • Werken bij een betrokken club met een eigen WebNLFoundation

Ons favoriete werk

Nieuwsgierig naar ons favoriete werk? Als Merkstrateeg bij WebNL kun je onder andere meewerken aan de volgende cases:

  • Vrijbuiter: een positioneringsstrategie die het 'Altijd vakantie'-gevoel claimt
  • Purple: een nieuwe naam en strategie voor een ambitieuze scale-up
  • Visser & Visser: een topkantoor strategisch vooruit brengen bij herpositionering

Voor wie ‘Alles mooier en beter’ wil maken

Bij WebNL zetten ambitieuze professionals zich in om organisaties mooier en beter te maken. Dat doen we vanuit onze creative studios en bij klanten op locatie. We staan bekend om onze open cultuur, uitdagende opdrachten en enthousiaste collega's. WebNL biedt een plek waar je inspiratie opdoet en waar je al je creativiteit kwijt kunt! Bouw jij mee aan de groei van onze creative studios?

Het hart van WebNL

De creative studios! Onze kleurrijke vestigingen met veel ruimte om te werken én te ontspannen met elkaar. Je vindt onze locaties in Stellendam, Rotterdam, Zwolle en Utrecht. Daar zijn we trots op!

title: Senior Marketing Manager
descriptionHtml:
Wij zijn de snelst groeiende logistieke speler van Europa.

InPost Group is geen gewone logistieke dienstverlener. We zijn de #1 out-of-home bezorgdienst van Europa: beursgenoteerd, actief in 9 landen, en met een groeicurve die zich zelden voordoet. Van 14.000 pakketautomaten in 2019 naar meer dan 61.000 in 2025. Meer dan 1,4 miljard leveringen per jaar. Een groepsomzet van €3,4 miljard: met >30% groei in één jaar. En we zijn nog lang niet klaar.

In Nederland opereren we als Mondial Relay by InPost Group. We zijn hier volop in opbouw. Dat betekent: invloed, impact en ruimte om écht iets neer te zetten. Voor die volgende fase zoeken we een Business Controller met een scherpe financiële blik, een data-driven mindset en de drive om processen slimmer, sneller en schaalbaarder te maken.

Vacatureomschrijving

Bouw jij het merk InPost verder uit in Nederland?

In Nederland zijn we volop in ontwikkeling. Daarom zoeken we een Senior Marketing Manager die onze merkpositionering versterkt, onze klantpropositie verder ontwikkelt en marketing stevig binnen de organisatie neerzet.

title: Gaming & Consumer Marketing Lead - Europe
descriptionHtml:
Gaming is at the heart of this role and represents around 90% of its scope. We’re looking for someone who knows the gaming world well and brings strong, hands-on experience in the industry or gaming ecosystem.

About The Role

You’ll own the European marketing strategy across our gaming and consumer portfolio, covering AOC, AGON, Philips Monitors and Evnia.

This is a senior, hands-on role with real ownership across brand, product and commercial marketing. You’ll shape how our products show up across European markets - from positioning and launches to partnerships, digital presence, retail visibility and sell-through - working closely with Product Marketing, Communications & Advertising, Digital, E-commerce and our local markets.

What You'll Own

Strategy and planning

  • Own the European gaming and consumer marketing strategy and annual plan across both brands.
  • Develop and challenge country plans against local sales goals, business priorities and market opportunities.
  • Track competitors, gaming trends, consumer behaviour and market developments to identify gaps and opportunities and keep the strategy evidence-led.

Brand, product and content

  • Shape product positioning together with Product Marketing, with a clear focus on priority and flagship products.
  • Drive brand consistency and quality across consumer-facing activity for both brands.
  • Own the quality, relevance and visibility of consumer-facing content across our websites.
  • Work with Communications & Advertising on the direction and content of our social channels.

Launches, partnerships and events

  • Lead gaming and consumer product launches from strategy through activation, aligning positioning, content, channels, partnerships and events across European markets.
  • Own gaming and consumer partnerships, including evaluating their impact, visibility and activation across markets.
  • Lead our presence at relevant consumer events and tradeshows.

Commercial impact

  • Connect marketing activity directly to commercial performance, improving product visibility, conversion and sell-through across retail and e-tail partners.

Leadership, budget and reporting

  • Lead, prioritise and develop the Consumer Marketing team.
  • Own performance KPIs and the marketing budget, including allocation across design, specialist support and digital activity.
  • Set the B2C strategic direction in partnership with Communications & Advertising, ensuring PR and advertising support the wider marketing strategy.
  • Report on performance and review results with the Director and European markets.

What You Bring

  • Strong professional experience in gaming marketing, with a genuine understanding of the gaming audience, ecosystem and category.
  • Substantial consumer marketing experience, ideally within consumer electronics, gaming or another fast-moving technology category.
  • A track record of owning brand and product marketing across multiple European markets.
  • Experience leading and developing a small team.
  • Strong commercial awareness and a clear understanding of how marketing activity translates into sell-through.
  • Confidence owning budgets, KPIs and performance reporting for senior stakeholders.
  • Fluent English; another European language is an advantage.
  • Willingness to travel within Europe for events and market visits.

Why this role

This is a high-ownership European role with direct influence on strategy, launches, partnerships and commercial performance.

You’ll work across established and fast-growing gaming and consumer brands, lead a team, own meaningful budget and help shape how our products reach consumers across Europe.

title: Marketing Lead | FMCG | ENG Only
descriptionHtml:
Are you ready to help turn a food brand into a cultural phenomenon across Europe?


We are recruiting a Marketing Lead on behalf of our client, an international food and beverage company that has built one of its category's most recognisable challenger brands worldwide. That brand grew by turning a bold, distinctive product into a genuine cultural moment, and our client is now using that momentum to build a second brand from the ground up for the European market.


Depending on your experience and strengths, you will either grow an established global challenger brand or help build a new brand from scratch, working closely with European colleagues and the wider international team, with plenty of room to challenge, experiment and turn ideas into action.


This is not a role where you simply manage an existing playbook, you help write it. You join at a moment where the opportunity is significant and the foundations are still being built, with real scope to shape the direction and see the impact of your work.


Key Responsibilities

  • Develop, implement and manage the annual marketing strategy in line with overall business objectives
  • Oversee and optimise the marketing budget to maximise return across initiatives
  • Drive end-to-end marketing campaigns with a strong focus on digital activation and performance, identifying the biggest opportunities to grow awareness, trial, penetration and brand equity
  • Lead key strategic projects spanning markets, consumers, portfolio and occasions
  • Work closely with the other marketing leads across brand, media and digital, and with sales and trade marketing, to deliver integrated marketing plans
  • Connect consumer, category, customer and business perspectives to inform sharp commercial decisions
  • Partner with the international team and constructively challenge where European market needs call for a different approach
  • Maintain strong relationships with key stakeholders, including agencies, partners and media outlets
  • Coach and develop Brand Managers, helping them translate strategy into strong execution
  • Track brand and business performance and turn data into clear, actionable recommendations
  • Monitor and report on the effectiveness of marketing initiatives, providing data-driven insights
  • Ensure brand consistency across all communication channels and materials


Qualifications & Skills

  • 10+ years of experience in FMCG or food marketing, ideally managing sizeable consumer brands in the European market
  • Able to commute to the office in Amstelveen, at least 4 days a week
  • Strong track record in brand building and driving commercial growth
  • Broad understanding of the marketing function, with particular strength in digital marketing and growing a brand's P&L
  • A strategic thinker, equally comfortable in the detail and in making things happen
  • Strong consumer understanding, with the ability to turn insight into action
  • A confident stakeholder manager, able to influence senior stakeholders in an international environment
  • Strong leadership and people management skills, with a track record of coaching and developing talent
  • Entrepreneurial, resilient and proactive, someone who spots an opportunity and works out how to make it happen
  • A genuine interest in brands, culture and what drives consumer behaviour
  • Excellent communication, negotiation and interpersonal skills
  • Professional fluency in English; additional European languages are an advantage


What's On Offer

  • Gross annual salary between €80,000 and €135,000, depending on experience, excluding 8% holiday allowance
  • Pension plan
  • Commuting benefit
  • Vitality benefit of €50 per month
  • Lease bike option
  • 25 days of paid time off per year
  • Company laptop and phone
  • Accident insurance and WIA gap insurance
  • Office location in the centre of Amstelveen
  • An international team of experienced colleagues

title: Commercieel Merkstrateeg
descriptionHtml:
Commercieel Merkstrateeg bij Sterk Merkregisseurs (branding agency)

📍 Eindhoven | 32 - 40 uur | 💰 Salaris € 4000 – € 5300 o.b.v. fulltime

👉 Interessant pakket - jaarlijks opleidingsbudget


Ben jij een commerciële denker en doener en krijg je energie wanneer jouw strategieën worden vertaald naar branding campagnes? Als Commercieel Merkstrateeg bij onze opdrachtgever Sterk, een branding agency, word jij de drijvende kracht achter de groei van jouw klantenportfolio. Je bent verantwoordelijk voor het verkoopproces van A tot Z vanuit een commercieel adviserende rol. Belangrijk zijn het onderhouden van klantrelaties met bestaande klanten en het werven van nieuwe klanten. Je vertaalt klantambities naar strategieën, je bent een sparringpartner voor klanten en collega’s en je weet commerciële kansen te benutten. Je taken zijn heel gevarieerd, gaande van merk- en campagneplannen tot evaluaties en klantgesprekken op strategisch niveau. Kortom, jij zorgt ervoor dat Sterk altijd een stap vooruit blijft en duurzame relaties opbouwt. Je krijgt veel ruimte voor eigen inbreng en een interessant pakket met jaarlijks opleidingsbudget. Solliciteer nu!


Wat ga je doen?

Jij bent de cruciale, strategische schakel in het team tussen externe klanten en je collega's. Enkele van jouw verantwoordelijkheden zijn:

  • Duurzame klant- en partnerrelaties opbouwen, onderhouden en nieuwe klanten werven;
  • Toezicht houden op en bereiken van commerciële teamoutput via KPI’s;
  • Commerciële kansen signaleren en opvolgen + op de hoogte blijven van branchetrends;
  • Inzicht verwerven in klantbehoeften door analyse en proactief anticiperen;
  • Sparringpartner en aanspreekpunt zijn voor opdrachtgevers en externe partners;
  • De communicatie tussen klanten en collega’s in goede banen leiden.


Wat krijg je?

Ga je aan de slag bij Sterk, dan kom je terecht in creatief, menselijk team boordevol ambitie en groeimogelijkheden. Daarnaast krijg je:

  • Bruto maandsalaris tussen € 4000 en € 5300 (op basis van 40 uur) afhankelijk van je kennis en ervaring;
  • Een contract in loondienst bij onze opdrachtgever;
  • Aantrekkelijk jaarlijks opleidingsbudget;
  • Flexibele werktijden en deels thuiswerken met thuiswerkvergoeding;
  • Alle ruimte voor eigen inbreng, ontwikkeling en inspiratie. Projecten waar je trots op kunt zijn (en die prijzen kunnen winnen);
  • Collega’s die jouw strategie waarderen en samen mijlpalen vieren.


Wie is jouw nieuwe werkgever?

Sterk Merkregisseurs is een branding agency dat zich richt op employer branding, arbeidsmarktcommunicatie, merkstrategie en datagedreven marketing. SMS Intermediair helpt hen bij het vinden van nieuwe collega’s. Sterk werkt voor mooie klanten als Heineken, ISS en PLUS aan campagnes die opvallen én werken. Van het aantrekken van technische professionals tot het neerzetten van een sterk werkgeversmerk of het uitvoeren van een imago-onderzoek – ze bedenken en maken het zelf, van strategie tot creatie.


Wie ben jij?:

Je bent commercieel ingesteld, je hebt strategisch inzicht en maakt duidelijke afspraken om doelen te bereiken. Verder ben je:

  • Een strateeg met commerciële ervaring die energie krijgt van zowel strategie bepalen als uitvoeren met minimaal 3 tot 5 jaar ervaring in een vergelijkbare rol. Bij voorkeur heb je affiniteit met de (online) bureauwereld of vergelijkbare ervaring aan klantzijde;
  • Je zet zelf de strategie uit en bepaalt doelen en prioriteiten voor je team op een pragmatische en hands-on manier;
  • Klantgericht: je bent een relatiemanager en onderhoudt relaties met bestaande klanten en werft nieuwe klanten door prioriteit te geven aan klantadvies;
  • Resultaatgericht: je werkt vanuit doelen met het oog op efficiëntie en commerciële targets behalen;
  • Proactief: je neemt initiatief en bent altijd op zoek naar mogelijkheden om jouw doelen te bereiken;
  • Taalgevoelig: in Nederlands top, in Engels goed;
  • Zelfstandig en professioneel, maar ook een teamspeler met humor.


👉 Klaar voor de volgende stap? Solliciteer direct of mail je cv naar kenny@sms-intermediair.nl

Vragen? Bellen kan ook naar 040-2114075.
